title: Session summary
sqlTemplate: select count(*) filter (where type = 'view') as views, count(*) filter (where type = 'action') as actions, count(*) filter (where type = 'error') as errors, count(*) filter (where type = 'resource') as resources, min(_timestamp) as session_start_us, max(_timestamp) as session_end_us from _rumdata where session_id = {{session_id}}
emptyDataSemantics: No records for this exact session_id -> all counts 0 and session_start_us/session_end_us are SQL NULL -> the session itself is NO_DATA/not found, never rendered as a valid empty session.
